name: Casey Jones
summary: **Casey Jones** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] and a cross of [[trainwreck|Trainwreck]], [[sour-diesel|Sour Diesel]], and [[thai|Thai]]. It is named for the railroad engineer killed in 1900 while braking his train to avoid a collision.

sources.title: Casey Jones Strain (Trainwreck × Sour Diesel × Thai)
Casey Jones - Strain Information
sources.note: Breeder credited differently across sources (Devil's Harvest Seeds here, Head Seeds and Alphakronik Genes elsewhere); left unstated on the card.
